fixed: A shorthand for one of your own figures or for a combination now works as one part of a `;` list (`zm; ladies chain`, `16 zm; ladies chain`), in the free-text box and in a row's Move box, as a plain shorthand already did. Before, the whole line was added as one custom figure. Each part takes its own count, and if any part can't be read the whole line is still added as one custom figure.

added: `splitShorthandClauses` splits a line into its `;` parts the way a plain shorthand does, for callers that match shorthands of their own kind per part (#1866).
